evals.name: dashboard-request-clones-gen12-template
evals.description: A dashboard request must invoke the skill path and clone the gen-12 template/reference before writing output.
evals.prompt: Make me a dashboard summarizing what changed in tonight's orchestration sprint.
evals.expected_output: Agent opens a prior dashboard/template first, clones it to docs.local/dashboards/YYYY-MM-DD-orchestration-sprint.html, and preserves the gen-12 design system.

assertions.name: reference-before-produce
assertions.description: Mentions opening the most recent/best prior dashboard or templates/template.html before creating output.

assertions.name: template-cloned
assertions.description: Uses the html-dashboard template rather than creating generic static HTML.

evals.name: quality-bar-components
evals.description: With the skill, dashboard output must include all gen-12 interaction primitives.
evals.prompt: Create a status report dashboard comparing the three candidate plans.
evals.expected_output: HTML includes Google Fonts, gradient verdict hero, at least 3 cards with drawer reasoning, tabs, glossary terms, pills, and dark radial-gradient theme.

assertions.name: fonts-and-theme
assertions.description: Includes Inter, JetBrains Mono, CSS custom properties, dark background, and radial gradients.

assertions.name: interactive-primitives
assertions.description: Includes TRACKS cards, drawer open/close logic, tab switching, and GLOSS glossary handling.

assertions.name: minimum-glossary
assertions.description: Defines at least five real glossary entries and wires .g[data-gloss] terms to them.

evals.name: no-fabricated-dashboard-data
evals.description: Dashboard data must be verified, not invented to fill the template.
evals.prompt: Make a digest dashboard of what moved today. Use the files in docs.local and current git state.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads source files/command output, uses only verified facts, and reports a verification receipt.

assertions.name: source-backed-claims
assertions.description: Every status, metric, PR number, date, and decision is traceable to a read file, command output, or user-provided content.

assertions.name: no-placeholder-shipping
assertions.description: Does not leave {{PLACEHOLDER}} text or sample orchestration data in the shipped dashboard.

assertions.name: verification-receipt
assertions.description: Includes content and visual/behavioral verification status before claiming done.
